title: Dwarf Breaks Out: a roguelite brick-breaker built with Claude. Looking for feedback before launch
author: yukajii
selftext:
I’m building a roguelite Breakout/Arkanoid for [itch.io](http://itch.io) and I'm about ready to launch. But I want to make sure it's fun not only to me, so I'd love to get some feedback.

TLDR You’re a dwarf digging down through a mine. Your pickaxe is the ball and your shield is the paddle. Pick boons between stages, choose your path down a branching map, fight bosses, and spend ore in the Hall between runs to unlock new dwarves and gear.

**I**t works for both desktop and mobile, in browser.

[https://yukajii.itch.io/dwarf-breaks-out](https://yukajii.itch.io/dwarf-breaks-out)   
Password: 1234

Things I’d especially like to hear about:

* Is it clear what to do in the first couple of runs?
* Which boons feel useless, and which feel too strong?
* Anything that breaks or feels off
* Where you died, and whether it felt fair
* If font are hard to read

A run takes 10–20 minutes. Thanks for playing!
